findings.subject: production-evidence
findings.description: No actual Windows/Site Builder/HUB production evidence source was available.
findings.whyItMatters: Production mapping and safety cannot be inferred from local state or fixtures.
findings.requiredResolution: Collect and validate the full read-only evidence bundle from the actual environment.

findings.subject: all-production-installations
findings.description: No explicit production identity chain can be proven.
findings.whyItMatters: A binding could target the wrong installation.
findings.requiredResolution: Build and human-review the explicit mapping from validated compatible sources.
findings.s2Impact: Blocks binding schema and backfill approval.

findings.subject: mongo-deployment
findings.description: Mongo topology, durability and access controls are unknown.
findings.whyItMatters: Even additive mutation is unsafe without storage and security proof.
findings.requiredResolution: Collect topology/security metadata and remediate every blocker.
findings.s2Impact: May require security or deployment work first.

findings.subject: production-recovery
findings.description: No verified backup, retention/PITR or restore proof is available.
findings.whyItMatters: Document rollback does not replace recoverable storage.
findings.requiredResolution: Provide latest-success, retention and tested-restore evidence.
